quote: You spend years building walls to keep the pain out. You forget that the same walls lock the warmth away too. Every secret scar becomes a heavy anchor tying you to the past. You wander through silent rooms searching for a lost version of yourself. Nobody can rescue you from the shadows you refuse to leave behind. True healing begins only when you finally decide to unlock the door.
